about: Who the gate's people are and what they do. figures: scroll figures from figures.json, played at their spots; do = [clip, seconds] steps cycled with cross-fades; nudge = [dX, dD] metres where our model needs it (reasons in nudge_why). walkers: people who follow a path back and forth. traffic: a seeded crowd along a path (lanes = sideways offsets from it, + = left of the direction of travel), with stops to look at the view and pairs who walk together and stop to talk. Clips are the characters' clips in web/public/assets/chars/characters.json. Paths are [X, D] in the section frame, or {route: [from, to]}: stations (metres from the gate passage's outer mouth, + east) along the mapped road, resolved by the page from layout.json. Walk clips play at the rate that matches the walker speed (stride measured from the planted foot in people.js).

nudge_why.tax_official: sits on the bench behind the desk (bench at D 12.9-13.2); his feet are hidden in the painting
nudge_why.rail watchers: legs hidden behind the railing: stand 0.3 m behind the near railing's inner face so the elbows rest on its top rail (lean_chin keeps the feet under the hips); bridge_sightseer steps off the post at X 3.5, and watchers 3 and 4 stand 0.8 m apart so their elbows don't meet
nudge_why.wall_recliner: his foot (hidden, estimated) maps 1.1 m inside the north wing that the build runs north from the gate block (the strokes show no wall there, only trees); he leans against its outer face as painted
nudge_why.tower_watchman: painted in the middle of the hall doorway (bay X -21.05..-19.15); now that people have bodies he would block the way in, so he stands 0.6 m to the side of it

traffic.path_why: the mapped road (layout.json route, S5.road.main) from the street inside the city, through the passage and over the bridge; walkers route round anyone standing on it

clips_why: 2026-10-10 audit (gen/characters/audit_walks/): nobody walks with 'carry' (carter: Carry Heavy Object Walk = both arms held straight out, a zombie without the box; porter: Carry Water Bucket Walk = bends double to the ground) or the sightseer's 'stroll' (Thoughtful Walk = head hanging, arms limp); 'gape' (Look Around Dumbfounded) is out of every cycle. 'idle' is Meshy Idle 3 (243), a calm stand, on every character (the old idle 0 turned round and flung an arm behind). Carrying comes back with props (shoulder pole, baskets).
